items.informal_name: Algebra Equivalence for Multivariate Polynomials with Incremented Index Type
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) [inst : CommSemiring R] (n : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R),
  (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv R n) p =
    (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (Polynomial.C.comp MvPolynomial.C) fun i =>
        Fin.cases Polynomial.X (fun k => Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X k)) i)
      p
items.informal_description: There is an algebra equivalence between the ring of multivariate polynomials over $ \text{Fin}(n+1) $ with coefficients in a commutative semiring $ R $, and the polynomial ring in one variable whose coefficients are multivariate polynomials over $ R $ with variables indexed by $ \text{Fin}(n) $. This equivalence is constructed via the bijection $ \text{Fin}(n+1) \simeq \text{Option}(\text{Fin}(n)) $, mapping the $ \text{none} $ case to the outer polynomial indeterminate and $ \text{some } k $ cases to inner variables. The equivalence preserves addition, multiplication, and scalar multiplication by elements of $ R $.

items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ),
  ⇑(MvPolynomial.expand p) = MvPolynomial.eval₂ MvPolynomial.C ((fun s => MvPolynomial.X s) ^ p)
items.informal_description: The algebra homomorphism over $ R $ that substitutes each variable $ X_i $ in the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $ with $ X_i^p $, effectively expanding the polynomial by raising each variable to the $ p $-th power.

items.informal_name: bind₁ Applied to a Monomial Yields Product of Substitutions
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : σ → MvPolynomial τ R) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (r : R),
  (MvPolynomial.bind₁ f) ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) r) = MvPolynomial.C r * ∏ i ∈ d.support, f i ^ d i
items.informal_description: For any substitution function $ f : \sigma \to R[\tau] $, finite exponent vector $ d : \sigma \to_0 \mathbb{N} $, and coefficient $ r \in R $, applying the variable substitution homomorphism $ \text{bind}_1 $ to the monomial $ \text{monomial}(d, r) $ results in the product of the constant polynomial $ C(r) $ and the product over $ f(i)^{d(i)} $ for all $ i $ in the support of $ d $. Formally, $ \text{bind}_1(f)(\text{monomial}(d, r)) = C(r) \cdot \prod_{i \in \text{support}(d)} f(i)^{d(i)} $.

items.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_3} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → ℕ → MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial σ R
items.informal_description: The algebra homomorphism over $ R $ that substitutes each variable $ X_i $ in the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $ with $ X_i^p $, effectively expanding the polynomial by raising each variable to the $ p $-th power. This is defined using the variable substitution homomorphism $ \text{bind}_1 $, mapping $ X_i $ to $ X_i^p $.

items.type: {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_3} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ (MvPolynomial σ R) →+* MvPolynomial σ R
items.informal_description: The ring homomorphism that flattens a multivariate polynomial in variables $\sigma$ with coefficients in another multivariate polynomial ring $R[\sigma]$ by substituting the inner variables with the outer variables. Specifically, it evaluates each polynomial in $R[\sigma][\sigma]$ by interpreting the coefficients (which are polynomials in $\sigma$) using the identity map on coefficients and variables, resulting in a single polynomial in $R[\sigma]$.

items.informal_name: Algebra Evaluation Homomorphism for Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
{R : Type u} →
  {S₁ : Type v} →
    {σ : Type u_1} →
      [inst : CommSemiring R] →
        [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] → [inst_2 : Algebra R S₁] → (σ → S₁) → MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] S₁
items.informal_description: The algebra homomorphism from the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $ to a commutative semiring $ S_1 $ equipped with an $ R $-algebra structure, defined by evaluating polynomials using the canonical algebra map $ R \to S_1 $ for coefficients and a given variable assignment $ \sigma \to S_1 $. This homomorphism preserves addition, multiplication, scalar multiplication by $ R $, and maps the constant polynomial $ C(r) $ to $ \text{algebraMap}(r) $ for all $ r \in R $.

items.type:
(A : Type u_1) →
  (B : Type u_2) →
    [inst : CommSemiring A] → [inst_1 : CommSemiring B] → [inst_2 : Algebra A B] → MvPolynomial B A →ₐ[A] B
items.informal_description: The algebra homomorphism from the multivariate polynomial ring $ A[B] $ to $ B $ that evaluates each polynomial by substituting variables with their corresponding elements in $ B $, using the algebra structure of $ B $ over $ A $.

items.informal_name: Evaluation homomorphism for multivariate polynomials over finite set
items.type:
(R : Type u) →
  [inst : CommSemiring R] →
    {S : Type v} →
      [inst_1 : CommSemiring S] → [inst_2 : Algebra R S] → (s : Finset S) → MvPolynomial (Fin s.card) R →ₐ[R] S
items.informal_description: For a finite set $ s $ of elements in $ S $, this defines an algebra homomorphism from the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[X_1,\ldots,X_n] $ (with $ n = |s| $) to $ S $. The homomorphism evaluates each variable $ X_i $ to the $ i $-th element of $ s $ under the canonical bijection between $ \mathrm{Fin}(n) $ and $ s $, preserving the algebra structure of $ R $-linear combinations and polynomial multiplication.

items.informal_name: Definition of Algebra Evaluation Homomorphism for Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S₁ : Type v} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : CommSemiring S₁] [inst_2 : Algebra R S₁]
  (f : σ → S₁) (p : MvPolynomial σ R), (MvPolynomial.aeval f) p = MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap R S₁) f p
items.informal_description: The algebra evaluation homomorphism for multivariate polynomials is defined by evaluating each polynomial using the canonical algebra map from $ R $ to $ S_1 $ for coefficients and a given variable assignment $ f : \sigma \to S_1 $, such that $ \text{aeval}\, f\, p = \text{eval}_2(\text{algebraMap}(R, S_1), f, p) $.

items.informal_name: Evaluation Algebra Homomorphism for Multivariate Polynomials over an Algebra Tower
items.type:
{R : Type u} →
  {σ : Type u_1} →
    [inst : CommSemiring R] →
      {S : Type u_2} →
        {A : Type u_3} →
          [inst_1 : CommSemiring S] →
            [inst_2 : CommSemiring A] →
              [inst_3 : Algebra S R] → [inst_4 : Algebra S A] → (R →ₐ[S] A) → (σ → A) → MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[S] A
items.informal_description: Given an $ S $-algebra homomorphism $ f : R \to A $ and a variable assignment $ X : \sigma \to A $, this constructs the algebra homomorphism from the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $ to $ A $ that evaluates each polynomial by applying $ f $ to coefficients and $ X $ to variables. The homomorphism preserves the $ S $-algebra structure, ensuring compatibility with scalar multiplication and the algebra operations.
